red_tests.failure_fingerprint: Replacing scripts/jira_query.py with the previous twg CLI invocation in orchestrator-dispatch.yml failed 2 tests: test_workflow_refreshes_token_before_query ('refresh must run before the query') and test_workflow_does_not_invoke_twg ('workflow still invokes twg'). Confirms the tests fail if the CLI returns or the ordering regresses.

rationale: KAN-264: the Teamwork Graph CLI cannot run on a CI runner. Its OAuth scopes (:twg-cli, :twg) are not grantable through the Atlassian developer console, and twg login is an interactive device flow needing a browser. Replacing the poll with a direct Jira Cloud REST call under read:jira-work. Rotating refresh tokens still require the per-run refresh, so refresh_jira_token.py is retained and renamed off the TWG naming. Squash-merge re-anchor: PR #128 landed as squash commit e9b6c2be, so baseline_parent is re-anchored to that commit and test digests re-pinned to the merged content (KAN-260 precedent).
